pages.title: Armor Stand
pages.text: Leave two blocks of vertical clearance. Right-click the appropriate height with armor to fill that slot, or use an empty hand for the equipment menu. Sneak-right-click at a worn piece’s height to swap it with your own.
Apply redstone power to either half and sneak-right-click to swap the full set.

pages.title: Sword Pedestal
pages.text: Right-click with a sword to stand it upright. Right-click again to eject it. A displayed sword emits full redstone power. Right-click with dye to change the trim. Sneak-use either drill to rotate it.
Use the wool color you want when crafting.
